property_summary: After any valid call (exactly 10 ether at a strictly increasing timestamp at block number n), C's balance is 0 exactly when n % 15 == 0 and 10 ether otherwise; the mutant pays on the complement, so its balance is 0 exactly on non-multiples of 15, violating the rule.
change_summary: Invert the payout condition from block.number % 15 == 0 to block.number % 15 != 0, changing when the payout occurs.
